overview_description.description: Postpay partners with thousands of retail brands and e-commerce platforms, enabling customers to purchase products immediately and pay in three equal, interest-free installments over time. This model helps consumers manage cash flow while giving merchants a way to increase sales and customer conversion rates. The service is typically integrated at checkout, where shoppers can choose Postpay as a payment option and complete purchases through its app or payment gateway.
